rows.en: It's baseball, right?
It's soccer, right?
Which is it?!
Baseball
Soccer
B-baseball, please.
Wh-what did you say...?
There, you see?!!

Of course, of course! Meticulous strategy and
carefully laid setups, put to full use: baseball
is the perfect sport for our next class!

All right, let's go,
\p!!

Oh, okay!
Please don't drag me!!
Damn it! You two'd better remember this!!
S-soccer, please.
There, you see?! Gahaha!!

Of course, of course!
A ball's meant to be kicked, after all!!
(Things are getting ugly... I have to do something!)
Wh-why me...

...So you've finally come,
\p.
Huh, Hilda-sensei... what's the matter?
...I was waiting for you.
...Isn't there something you ought to tell me?

Where's this coming from all of a sudden...
Tell you? Not... really... anything? I think...
Sigh... then it can't be helped...

I have heard a rumor...
that you've been spending a lot of time with that girl...
rows.notes: 'ano onna' = 'that girl' (the player's love interest, unnamed).

rows.en:
I cannot let this go unchecked!
...A-as a teacher, that is!!
That is all! Hurry home now!!
Wh-what is it?

I have heard a rumor...
that you've been spending a lot of time with that boy...
rows.notes: 'ano otoko'; labelled male variant though it reads as the counterpart of c01144 for a female player.

rows.en:
Where's this coming from all of a sudden...
Tell you? Not... really... anything? I think...
I cannot let this go unchecked!

(Yamashiro-sensei called me in,
but what's this about...?)

\p.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Hello, Yamashiro-sensei.

Mm.
Have a seat there for now.
Um, what did you need me for today?

\p,
I hear your lecture attendance leaves a lot to be desired.
rows.notes: 'zagaku' = classroom study (vs. flight training). Refit to the measured 420 px window.

rows.en:
Th-that's not true...
I go to class like I'm supposed to!
And so, I'll be looking after you myself.
Huh? You, Yamashiro-sensei?

Helping students who've fallen behind improve
is part of a teacher's duty.
But I haven't fallen behind...

Relax, it's nothing difficult.
You'll just work through a little problem set.

If it's YOUR problem set, Sensei,
it's bound to be hard!

If you decide it's hard from the start,
you won't solve even the problems you could...
Now then, question one.
(H-he's not taking no for an answer!!)

The ASS-1, later rebuilt as the SDF-1 Macross,
crashed on a lone island in the Pacific.
What was the island's name?
East Liberia Island
South Ataria Island
West Canaria Island
This one, maybe...
Question two.

This Macross Frontier we live on...
which number Macross colony fleet is it?
...Ah, that one's a freebie.
25th Macross Colony Fleet
rows.notes: 'colony fleet' as in the corpus narration.

rows.en: 17th Macross Colony Fleet
37th Macross Colony Fleet
It's this one, right?
On to the next one, then.
Which of these is the Zentradi word for "enemy"?
Yack
Mizone
rows.notes: Zentradi word 'miizoon', romanized here; no glossary or wiki spelling checked.

rows.en: Deburan
rows.notes: Zentradi word 'deburan', romanized here; no glossary or wiki spelling checked.

rows.en: I think it's this one...

Hm...
Then let's grade it.

Hm, all correct.
So you can do it when you try.
Of course! I take my classes seriously!
Well, those were questions anyone should get right.
Next time, I'll prepare something tougher.

See you,
\p.
(Wait, this isn't a one-time thing...?)

So you did need remedial lessons after all...
At this rate, your graduation is in jeopardy.
Ugh, I'm sorry...
Well, if you can't do it, you can't do it.
I'll keep preparing questions for next time too.

Th-that's not true...
I go to class like I'm supposed to!
I don't think I've fallen behind, though...

If it's Yamashiro-sensei's problem set,
it already sounds hard...
(H-he's not taking no for an answer!!)
I take my classes seriously!
